title: The 31.3 TrustWallet-converged label is not supported by source changes
evidence: 31.2→31.3 semantic tree diff contains zero added, removed, changed or mode-changed source files; active source contains zero Trust Wallet or WalletConnect references.
risk: Operators and reviewers may believe custody/wallet functionality exists when it does not.
target_owner: release truth service and packaging pipeline
remediation: Derive all version labels from one manifest; forbid release names that lack a capability receipt; add source-diff and documentation-drift gates.
acceptance: A signed release receipt maps each advertised capability to exact source nodes and tests; Trust Wallet remains absent until implemented.

title: Aban live execution bypasses the stronger production per-operation runtime
evidence: Legacy apps/live constructs LiveExecutionAdapter after startup authorization; production LiveExecutionCoordinator owns per-operation approval, quote binding, idempotency, notional reservation, receipts and reconciliation but supports only alpaca and binance_spot.
risk: Two live authority models can diverge on approvals, risk reservations, receipts and recovery.
remediation: Implement one AbanTetherVenue adapter and route every Aban order/cancel/reconcile through the production coordinator. Retain legacy adapter only as a compatibility translator during shadow comparison.
acceptance: No Aban side effect is reachable without operation-specific authorization, risk reservation, deterministic receipt and reconciliation coverage.

title: Committed OpenAPI is stale
evidence: Runtime exposes 26 /api/v1/next-level operations missing from docs/contracts/openapi.json; scripts/export_openapi.py --check fails.
risk: Generated clients, documentation and security reviews operate on an incomplete API surface.
remediation: Regenerate from the frozen app, fail CI on byte drift, and bind the contract hash into the release receipt.
acceptance: Runtime/OpenAPI equality test passes from clean install and every non-health operation has authentication metadata.

title: Regime ensemble runtime is broken
evidence: tests/platform/test_next_level_suite.py fails because trend-breadth RegimeVote objects omit required rationale.
risk: A declared implemented capability fails during normal evaluation.
remediation: Provide deterministic rationales for every detector and add table-driven validation for every branch.
acceptance: All detector branches produce valid votes; focused and full regression suites pass.

title: Exact-flat trades can retain position dust
evidence: Closing Decimal(0.3333333333333333) to zero leaves 3.3333333E-9; current test explicitly accepts residual dust. Unmerged PR #52 specified exact-zero behavior.
risk: Residual positions can contaminate accounting, risk, borrow and reconciliation state.
remediation: Use target-aware quantization and canonical-zero normalization after bounded tolerance checks; preserve cost/accounting consistency.
acceptance: Back-to-flat transitions are exactly Decimal(0), borrowed balances reset correctly, and property tests cover precisions and flips.

title: Aban-specific rules are spread across generic modules and configuration
evidence: Short caps, leverage limits, symbol rules and rate limits appear in app.yaml, market_rules.json, asset registry, config validator, limiter and EnhancedAbanClient.
risk: Venue behavior can differ by entry point and generic code becomes coupled to one exchange.
remediation: Centralize venue-native constraints and endpoint capabilities in a versioned Aban rule book. Generic policy consumes normalized venue capabilities only.
acceptance: One authoritative Aban policy source; all consumers use it; divergence and unknown-rule tests fail closed.

title: Aban rate limiting is duplicated and priority is ignored
evidence: Global limiter is 50/min, EnhancedAbanClient defaults to 60/min, async wrapper applies global limiting around a client that also limits, and execute_request discards priority.
risk: Unpredictable latency, lower throughput, starvation and misleading priority semantics.
remediation: One token-bucket/queue per credential+endpoint class with explicit priorities, server retry-after handling and bounded concurrency.
acceptance: Stress tests prove rate compliance, fairness, priority ordering and no double acquisition.

title: Documented RateLimitedAbanSDK package import fails
evidence: trading_gym/adapters has no __init__.py while symbol_registry.py documents and executes from trading_gym.adapters import RateLimitedAbanSDK.
risk: Live self-test and external consumers fail despite unit tests passing with injected mocks.
remediation: Restore an explicit package facade or import the concrete module; add a public-import contract test.
acceptance: Documented import and symbol-registry live construction both succeed in a clean install.

title: Merged Aban retry-path unification has regressed
evidence: Current EnhancedAbanClient invokes a matching SDK method before falling back to _client._make_request; PR #26 deliberately removed this dual path.
risk: Retry, logging, mock injection and endpoint behavior differ depending on SDK surface shape.
remediation: Define one explicit transport protocol. If typed SDK methods are retained, wrap them behind the same retry/rate/error contract rather than opportunistic dispatch.
acceptance: Differential tests prove identical retry, error mapping and redaction for typed and fallback calls.

title: Live-trading consent and suitability logic is dormant
evidence: LiveTradingConsentStore and evaluate_live_trading_gate have no production callers, API routes, workflow registrations or tests.
risk: The intended TOS/consent boundary does not protect actual live paths.
remediation: Integrate consent as one mandatory generic live-admission prerequisite, distinct from venue policy and operation approval.
acceptance: Expired/mismatched/over-limit consent blocks every live venue and chain operation; paper/shadow defaults remain unaffected.

title: Trust Wallet is unimplemented
evidence: No active Trust Wallet or WalletConnect source references; 31.3 source is identical to 31.2.
risk: Misleading product claims and no actual non-custodial signing workflow.
target_owner: wallet session adapter plus production chain coordinator
remediation: Implement separate provider discovery/WalletConnect session, user-approved signing, server-side signed-intent verification, chain RPC/broadcast and reconciliation. Keep seed/private key outside main runtime.
acceptance: Account/chain/session binding, expiry, replay, user approval, server governance, simulation and reconciliation are independently tested.

title: Institutional and next-level capabilities are mostly API-only evaluators
evidence: Prior wiring matrix reports 159 institutional modules on API, 63 in agent runtime, zero in workflow or production runtime; next-level evaluators are callable but not a canonical decision loop.
risk: The product looks broad but evaluations do not consistently constrain recommendations, promotions or live readiness.
remediation: Create one evidence graph that executes required evaluators, records their receipts, resolves blockers and feeds governance/paper/shadow/live readiness.
acceptance: Each required gate has a target owner, unique test and observable effect on a decision lifecycle.

title: CI excludes the Axiom Forge package from core static, security and coverage gates
evidence: mypy, coverage and Bandit commands target apps and trading_gym but not axiomforge.
risk: New brain/agent/live-consent code can regress outside principal quality gates.
remediation: Include axiomforge in type, coverage, security, import, mutation and API-contract gates; partition optional dependencies explicitly.
acceptance: Every production package is covered by declared quality gates and omissions are machine-readable.

title: Emergency control is split across legacy panic/process controls and production kill switches
evidence: Legacy loop uses panic-file/process termination while production runtime maintains durable tenant/venue/symbol kill switches.
risk: One control may stop a process without closing durable admission, or close admission without stopping a legacy loop.
remediation: Make one durable emergency command fan out to admission closure, worker cancellation, adapter halt, reconciliation and alerts; retain process kill as last-resort effect.
acceptance: One command yields a durable receipt and verified halt across every live path; restart remains halted until explicit rearm.

title: AutoRollback is implemented but not on a production promotion path
evidence: AutoRollback is referenced only by its tests; model registry is used elsewhere but automatic rollback is not operationally wired.
risk: Performance degradation logic exists without protecting active model authority.
remediation: Connect shadow/champion evidence to governed promotion, monitored activation and rollback with immutable receipts.
acceptance: A degradation fixture triggers governed rollback and operator-visible evidence without self-promotion.

title: Multiple configuration authorities coexist
evidence: MasterConfig is effectively test-only while YAML loaders, environment keys, venue profiles and next-level globals form separate configuration paths.
risk: Different processes may interpret limits and endpoints differently.
remediation: Select one authoritative schema and create compatibility loaders; snapshot effective config per run/decision.
acceptance: Every process reports the same config identity and rejects unknown/conflicting fields.

title: Backend breadth greatly exceeds productized frontend workflows
evidence: 436 runtime HTTP operations versus 131 frontend route references; counts are not one-to-one but indicate a large operator-surface gap.
risk: Capabilities are discoverable only through raw API panels and cannot be safely operated end to end.
remediation: Prioritize decision lifecycle, evidence, consent, venue readiness, execution, reconciliation and incident replay instead of one form per endpoint.
acceptance: Newcomer and operator task tests complete critical workflows without direct API construction.

title: 29 modules have no production importer and 185 production modules lack direct test imports
evidence: Corrected package-relative import graph over 476 internal modules.
risk: Dormant or dynamically registered value may be orphaned; direct-test absence can hide leaf regressions.
remediation: Classify every no-import leaf as entrypoint, facade, plugin, generated, dormant, superseded or defect; map each material production module to acceptance evidence.
acceptance: No unexplained material orphan remains and dynamic registries have discovery tests.
